data.summary: 5+ years Senior Software Engineer specializing in distributed backend systems and digital payments. Expert in Java, Spring Boot, Microservices, Kafka, AWS, Docker, and Kubernetes. Builds resilient, event-driven APIs with low-latency processing, secure transactions, and scalable cloud-native deployments.

projects.name: Zelle Payment Integration | CitiBank (via Infovision Pvt Ltd)
projects.description:
Zelle Payment Integration | CitiBank (via Infovision Pvt Ltd)
Built microservices to enable send/request payments with Kafka-driven orchestration for US digital banking customers.
Implemented idempotent transaction handlers, improving payment success rate by 40%.
Deployed services on AWS with Docker/Kubernetes, achieving 99.9% uptime.

projects.name: Personal Loan & EMI Card Processing Platform | Tata Digital Ltd (via Dew Solutions Pvt Ltd)
projects.description:
Personal Loan & EMI Card Processing Platform | Tata Digital Ltd (via Dew Solutions Pvt Ltd)
Developed scalable backend services for loan eligibility, EMI validation, KYC verification, and disbursement.
Engineered APIs that reduced processing time by 40%, accelerating loan and EMI workflows.
Optimized SQL and caching, improving platform performance by 25%.

projects.name: LMS Modernization | Axis Bank Ltd
projects.description:
LMS Modernization | Axis Bank Ltd
Modernized LMS backend with REST APIs and third-party integrations for course and user management.
Increased automated test coverage to 80%+ with JUnit, strengthening release stability.
Delivered robust REST endpoints, lowering production support incidents .

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE (5+ YEARS)
Senior Software Engineer | May 2024 - Sep 2025
Infovision Pvt Ltd | Pune
Designed event-driven microservices and secure APIs for high-volume digital payments, focusing on scalability and low latency.
Implemented fault tolerance and idempotency patterns to ensure transaction consistency across distributed components.
Built observability with Splunk, ELK, Grafana, and Prometheus reducing mean time to resolution by 45% .
Partnered with product, QA, and security to align with compliance standards and improve
developer productivity by 30% .
Led optimization of payment service caching and batch processing, achieving 20% cost reduction
and a $50k quarterly savings for the company..
Implemented auto-scaling and circuit breakers to handle peak load across all environments, delivering 99.98% uptime during promo spikes consistently.
Technologies Used: Java 8, Spring Boot, Microservices, Apache Kafka, AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, CloudWatch), Docker, Kubernetes, JPA, REST APIs, API Gateway, Git, Jenkins, ELK, Grafana, Prometheus
Software Engineer | Feb 2022 - Feb 2024
Dew Solutions Pvt Ltd | Pune
Developed backend services and APIs for loan eligibility, KYC, card validation, and disbursement with robust error handling.
Orchestrated Kafka-based asynchronous workflows to maintain throughput and resilience under variable loads.
Optimized SQL and caching strategies to enhance data access patterns and reduce query overhead.
Automated deployments and releases via Docker/Kubernetes with CI/CD, improving release cadence by 40%
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to refine API contracts and reduce operational incidents by 35%.
Increased new customer acquisitions by 18% through optimized loan eligibility flow shortening onboarding time and boosting first month activation rates.
Scaled Kafka workflows to handle 4x peak load delivering 99.95% uptime and eliminating SLA violations during high traffic for customers .
Technologies Used: Java 8, Spring Boot, Microservices, Apache Kafka, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, JPA, REST APIs, Git, Jenkins, Caching, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory
Business System Analyst | Aug 2020 - Jan 2022
Axis Bank Ltd | Pune
Designed and delivered REST APIs for LMS course management, user workflows, and progress tracking.
Coordinated integrations with Coursera and internal platforms, ensuring data consistency and secure exchange.
Drove test strategy and code quality practices, increasing automated coverage and stabilizing releases by 35%.
Facilitated Agile ceremonies and backlog prioritization to improve delivery predictability by 30% .
Reduced onboarding time for new users by 40%, accelerating time-to-value and decreasing initial help desk requests across three pilot teams.
Achieved 99.95% uptime by implementing auto scaling and resilient deployment pipelines, ensuring continuous service during peak loads across holiday season.
Technologies Used: Java 8, Spring Boot,MySQL, REST APIs, Git, Jira, Agile/Scrum, Postman, JUnit
